ops.title: PR 1316: retain vanished dispatch candidates until their judges settle
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: desk-runner.py:3834-3840 and :3857. A previously live dispatch becomes absent or inactive; lane_vanished starts a pending judgment, then dispatches_gone removes it from ORCA_LIVE. Next pass no longer visits the candidate, so even a yes or None is never collected. Next executable step: retain an explicit pending disappearance candidate until its judgment posts an alarm or JUDGE-SILENCED; add a delayed-judge regression in CI.

ops.text: With no root order and a previously live dispatch now absent or inactive, delayed yes, unsure and None answers post exactly one LANE-GONE on a later pass.
A delayed no posts exactly one JUDGE-SILENCED, and subsequent passes do not repeat it.
